preprocessing.params: provided by the dataset: fixed-width 2.56 s windows of 128 samples (50 Hz) with 50% overlap; the paper uses them as-is, 'requiring no additional resampling or segmentation'; input 9 channels x 128 samples

provided by the dataset: body acceleration obtained from total acceleration by removing gravity with a Butterworth low-pass filter (0.3 Hz cutoff); channels body_acc_xyz, total_acc_xyz, body_gyro_xyz; the 561 precomputed features are NOT used
sensor-modality decomposition (Table 5/6): 25 subsets of the 9 raw channels by sensor, signal group and axis, a separate CTM per subset

booleanization.threshold: per channel, B = 4 quantile thresholds theta_{i,b} = Q_i(b/B) fit on the training set (best config); base model and Table 5 use B = 1 threshold = per-channel training-set mean (2 bins)
booleanization.description: Each raw sample of each of the 9 inertial channels is compared against B channel-specific thresholds (training-set mean for B = 1; training-set quantiles for B > 1, best B = 4 i.e. 5 bins, preferred over equal-width and k-means) and thermometer-encoded, giving X in {0,1}^(N x W*B) plus negations.

notes: Single dataset (UCI-HAR raw inertial signals, 9 x 128). Results come in three TM experiment blocks: Table 2 (means of 5 runs, 4 patch x Booleanization configs, CPU and Arduino UNO Q timings), Table 3 (best run of the 5-bin 9x114 config, 95.11% per Table 4 caption, printed as 0.951) and Table 5 (25 channel subsets, 9x114 patch, single mean threshold; record keeps 9 subsets). Table 5's run count is not stated; its all-9-channel accuracy (91.45%) differs from the Table 2 mean for the same config (91.03 +/- 0.36), so it is likely a single run, but the paper does not say. Text/table inconsistencies in the paper: Sec. 3.4 text gives 88.67%/61.83%/78.42%/71.06%/73.68% where Table 5 prints 88.66/61.82/78.41/71.05/73.70 (record follows the table). Sec. 2.4 defines theta_{i,b} = Q_i(b/B) for b = 1..B, which would put the last threshold at the maximum; the worked example speaks of 'four 25% quantile thresholds' for 5 bins - the exact quantile levels are therefore ambiguous. The paper writes P = 114 gives 14 patch positions (W - P), off by one from W - P + 1. Booleanization object describes the best (5-bin) configuration; the base model, the 2-bin Table 2 columns and all of Table 5 use one mean threshold per channel (fixed_threshold-like, fit on train). Baselines in Table 3 were re-run by the authors on raw signals with no stated hyper-parameters or run counts. T heuristic: T range sqrt(C/2) +/- 3 (Table 1), text says 7 +/- 3. The record's category 'image_classification' reflects the folder; the task is sensor time-series HAR.
